be.en: to exist or have a particular identity, quality, or state
uses: Please be ready before the lesson starts.
请在课程开始前准备好。
You will be able to review the lesson offline.
你将能够离线复习课程。
It is easier to learn when you are genuinely interested in the topic.
真正对话题感兴趣时，学习会更容易。
I want to be responsible for checking the final draft.
We are about to be ready to leave.
我们马上就要准备好出发了。
A good friend will be there for you when things get difficult.
遇到困难时，好朋友会支持并陪伴你。
derivatives: 作名词时可表示存在状态或生物。

have.en: to own, contain, experience, or take part in something
uses: I have enough time to review five words tonight.
我今晚有足够时间复习五个单词。
If you have a problem with the app, write down what happened.
如果你使用应用时遇到问题，请记下发生了什么。
I have to finish this report before noon.
我必须在中午前完成这份报告。
These two words have several meanings in common.
这两个词有几个共同的含义。
have a chance to do something
You have a chance to correct the sentence before submitting it.
提交前你有机会修改句子。
Many learners have difficulty remembering irregular verbs.
许多学习者难以记住不规则动词。

do.en: to perform an action, activity, or piece of work
uses: Just do your best and learn from each mistake.
尽力去做，并从每个错误中学习。
We can do the work in two short sessions.
我们可以分两个短时段完成这项工作。
If the plan is not working, do something about it today.
如果计划行不通，今天就采取措施。
Regular practice can help you do well in the test.
规律练习能帮助你在测试中取得好成绩。
I can do without my notes for this short review.
这次短复习不用笔记我也能应付。
Could you do me a favor and check this sentence?
你能帮我检查一下这个句子吗？
derivatives: 指重视行动并把事情做完的人。
常见于 one’s doing，表示某人的行为。

say.en: to express something in words or give information
uses: Please say the sentence clearly and at a natural speed.
请以自然语速清楚地说出这个句子。
The notice says that the library closes at six.
通知上说图书馆六点关门。
Remember to say hello to your new teammate.
Try to say what you mean instead of translating word for word.
尽量表达真实意思，不要逐字翻译。
I have something important to say about the schedule.
关于日程，我有重要的事情要说。
It is hard to say which option will work best.
很难判断哪个选项最有效。
derivatives: 常指广为流传的短句或固定说法。

go.en: to move or travel somewhere, or develop in a particular way
uses: I usually go to work by subway.
I need to go home before it gets dark.
The meeting should go well if we prepare carefully.
如果认真准备，会议应该会很顺利。
Let us go through the answers one more time.
我们再把答案检查一遍。
She plans to go on studying after dinner.
她打算晚饭后继续学习。
This example does not go with the meaning shown above.
这个例句与上面的含义不匹配。
derivatives: 作名词可表示进展，作形容词可表示现有的。

get.en: to obtain, reach, receive, or become something
uses: Your pronunciation will get better with focused practice.
专注练习会让你的发音变得更好。
开始工作；到达工作地点
Let us get to work before the room becomes noisy.
趁房间还没变吵，我们开始工作吧。
I want to get this task done before lunch.
我想在午饭前完成这项任务。
Please get in touch with me if the date changes.
如果日期有变，请联系我。
You will get used to speaking aloud every day.
你会逐渐习惯每天大声说英语。
It takes time to get rid of an old pronunciation habit.
改掉旧的发音习惯需要时间。
derivatives: 多见于复合词或技术语境。

can.en: to be able or permitted to do something
uses: You can review the difficult cards again tonight.
你今晚可以再次复习难词卡。
A clear example can help you remember the pattern.
清晰的例句能帮助你记住这个句型。
This phrase can be used for both work and daily life.
这个短语可用于工作和日常生活。
After practice, you can tell the difference between the two sounds.
练习后，你能分辨这两个音。
I can hardly hear the final consonant in this recording.
我几乎听不到录音里的尾辅音。
You can no longer change the answer after submitting it.
提交后你不能再修改答案。

know.en: to have information, understanding, or familiarity
uses: I know the answer, but I need time to explain it.
我知道答案，但需要时间解释。
She knows how to use the new system.
她知道如何使用新系统。
What do you know about this expression?
你对这个表达了解多少？
It takes time to get to know a new colleague.
了解一位新同事需要时间。
As far as I know, the meeting is still on Friday.
据我所知，会议仍定在周五。
You do not need to know every example by heart.
你不必把每个例句都背下来。
derivatives: 常用于 knowledge of/about，表示对某事的了解。

will.en: used to talk about the future, willingness, or a decision
uses: I will review the new verbs after dinner.
我晚饭后会复习这些新动词。
will be able to do something
You will be able to see your saved progress on another device.
你将能在另一台设备上看到已保存的进度。
The change will probably happen next week.
这项变化很可能在下周发生。
I will not give up because of one difficult lesson.
我不会因为一节难课而放弃。
Will you read this sentence aloud for me?
你愿意为我朗读这个句子吗？
Take a short break, if you will, and then continue.
如果你愿意，短暂休息后再继续。

would.en: used for imagined situations, polite requests, preferences, or past habits
uses: I would like to review the feedback once more.
I would rather practice one useful sentence than memorize a list.
我宁愿练一个实用句子，也不愿死记一张表。
Would you mind checking this answer for me?
你介意帮我检查这个答案吗？
It would be better to add a clear example here.
在这里加一个清楚的例子会更好。
After class, we would often review together.
以前下课后，我们常常一起复习。
I would have called you if I had known.
如果我知道，我本来会给你打电话。

make.en: to create, produce, cause, or perform an action
uses: We need to make a decision before Friday.
我们需要在周五前作出决定。
Specific feedback can make your writing better.
具体反馈能让你的写作更好。
Please make sure that your progress is saved.
请确保你的进度已经保存。
Ten focused minutes can make a real difference.
专注十分钟也能带来真正的改变。
The funny example made everyone remember the word.
那个有趣的例子让大家都记住了这个词。
Try to make the most of your study time.
尽量充分利用学习时间。
derivatives: 常表示制作过程或形成。

think.en: to use the mind, form an opinion, or consider something
uses: Take a moment to think about the meaning before answering.
回答前花一点时间思考含义。
I think that this example is easier to remember.
我认为这个例子更容易记。
Can you think of another situation for this phrase?
你能想到这个短语的另一个使用场景吗？
Think carefully before you choose an answer.
选择答案前请认真思考。
You should think twice before deleting all your progress.
删除全部进度前应该三思。
Let us think through the plan step by step.
我们逐步把这个计划考虑周全。
derivatives: 作名词表示思考方式，作形容词表示善于思考的。
指有某种思考方式的人。

see.en: to perceive with the eyes, understand, or meet someone
uses: You can see a difference after a week of practice.
练习一周后你能看出差异。
I see what you mean about the missing context.
我明白你所说的缺少语境的问题。
I often see her reading on the train.
我经常看见她在火车上看书。
We saw him cross the street safely, but the phrase is still see someone do something.
我们看见他安全过了马路；这里记忆的结构仍是 see someone do something。
I will see to the problem this afternoon.
我今天下午会处理这个问题。
Let us wait and see whether the new method works.
我们等等看新方法是否有效。
derivatives: 常见于 seeing that，表示“鉴于”。

come.en: to move toward a place, arrive, or reach a state
uses: Please come home before the storm begins.
请在暴风雨开始前回家。
We need to come to a decision today.
我们今天需要作出决定。
This expression comes from everyday conversation.
这个表达来自日常对话。
Can you come up with a natural example?
你能想出一个自然的例子吗？
Small daily goals can come true with steady effort.
通过持续努力，每日小目标能够实现。
You may come across this phrase in emails.
你可能会在邮件中遇到这个短语。
derivatives: 常放在时间名词前，如 the coming week。

take.en: to carry, accept, require, or perform an action
uses: Take your time and read the whole question.
I plan to take part in the weekly speaking practice.
我打算参加每周口语练习。
Take a short break when your attention drops.
注意力下降时休息一会儿。
We should take responsibility for our own mistakes.
我们应该为自己的错误负责。
Please take the pronunciation practice seriously.
it takes time to do something
It takes time to build active vocabulary.
建立主动词汇需要时间。
derivatives: 较少见，表示外表或举止吸引人。

want.en: to wish for or need something or to do something
uses: I want to improve my speaking this month.
I want you to explain why this option is correct.
我希望你解释这个选项为什么正确。
She wants the job badly and has prepared carefully.
她非常想得到这份工作，并做了认真准备。
I want more from this lesson than a short definition.
我希望从这节课学到的不只是一条简短释义。
The plan failed for want of clear instructions.
这个计划因缺少清晰说明而失败。
The last thing you want is to lose saved progress.
你最不希望发生的事就是丢失已保存的进度。
derivatives: 常用于 unwanted messages 或 effects。

could.en: used for past ability, possibility, or polite suggestions and requests
uses: We could review the difficult cards first.
我们可以先复习难词卡。
Could you read the example aloud?
Your explanation could be true, but we need evidence.
你的解释可能是真的，但我们需要证据。
I could have saved more time by planning ahead.
如果提前计划，我本可以节省更多时间。
I could hardly understand the recording at first.
一开始我几乎听不懂这段录音。
I could not help smiling at the example.
看到这个例子，我忍不住笑了。

look.en: to direct the eyes, appear, or search for something
uses: Look at the whole sentence before choosing an answer.
选择答案前先看完整句子。
I am looking for a more natural expression.
我正在寻找一个更自然的表达。
This word looks like another one but means something different.
这个词看起来像另一个词，但含义不同。
I look forward to seeing your next example.
我期待看到你的下一个例子。
We need to look into why the progress was not saved.
我们需要调查进度为什么没有保存。
She looks after her younger brother after school.
derivatives: 口语中也可指外表好看的人。

use.en: to employ something for a purpose
uses: Use this example to remember the structure.
用这个例子记住这个结构。
You can use the search box for finding old cards.
你可以使用搜索框查找旧词卡。
This button is used to save your answer.
这个按钮用于保存答案。
I am used to reviewing words before bed.
I used to translate every sentence word for word.
我过去常常逐字翻译每个句子。
Try to make good use of the example sentences.
尽量充分利用这些例句。
derivatives: 用于描述词语或事物的使用方式。
表示不能达到所需目的。

tell.en: to give information, narrate, or recognize a difference
uses: Please tell me the reason for your choice.
请告诉我你选择的理由。
The teacher told us to read the sentence aloud.
老师让我们朗读这个句子。
It is always better to tell the truth.
Can you tell a short story using this verb?
你能用这个动词讲一个小故事吗？
I can now tell the difference between the two structures.
我现在能分辨这两个结构的差异。
Time will tell whether the new habit lasts.
时间会证明这个新习惯能否保持。
derivatives: 可指讲故事的人或银行出纳员。

find.en: to discover, locate, or form an opinion after experience
uses: Read the context carefully to find the answer.
仔细阅读语境来找到答案。
I want to find out why the record returned.
我想查明记录为什么又出现了。
find it difficult to do something
Many learners find it difficult to speak without translating.
许多学习者觉得不经翻译直接说英语很难。
find a way to do something
We will find a way to keep your progress safe.
我们会找到保护你进度的方法。
I found him checking the same answer again.
我发现他又在检查同一个答案。
You may find yourself using the phrase naturally.
你可能会发现自己很自然地用出了这个短语。
derivatives: 常用于研究或调查语境。
常见于复合词或产品名称。

give.en: to transfer, provide, or cause someone to receive something
uses: Could you give me some advice about pronunciation?
你能给我一些发音方面的建议吗？
The app gives each learner five new cards a day.
这个应用每天给每位学习者五张新词卡。
Please give the document to your manager.
Do not give up practicing after one mistake.
不要因为一个错误就放弃练习。
The retry button gives you a chance to correct the answer.
重试按钮让你有机会改正答案。
Unclear instructions can give rise to avoidable mistakes.
不清楚的说明会导致本可避免的错误。
derivatives: 描述愿意给予帮助或时间的人。

need.en: to require something because it is necessary
uses: I need more time to understand this structure.
我需要更多时间理解这个结构。
You need to finish the sentence before submitting it.
你需要在提交前完成句子。
We need you to describe the problem clearly.
我们需要你清楚地描述问题。
The old examples need replacing with natural ones.
旧例句需要换成自然的例句。
there is no need to do something
There is no need to memorize every definition at once.
没有必要一次背下每条释义。
The review plan should meet each learner’s needs.
复习计划应该满足每位学习者的需要。
derivatives: 作名词常见于 meet a need。
表示可以避免或没有必要。

should.en: used to express advice, duty, expectation, or probability
uses: You should read the full context before answering.
回答前你应该读完整语境。
should be able to do something
You should be able to continue from your saved position.
你应该能从保存的位置继续。
I should have checked the sentence more carefully.
我本应该更仔细地检查这个句子。
This structure should not be confused with the noun form.
这个结构不应与名词形式混淆。
What should I do if the sync fails again?
如果同步再次失败，我该怎么办？
Six natural examples should be enough to show the main uses.
六个自然例句应该足以展示主要用法。

work.en: to do a job, make an effort, or function successfully
uses: I need to work on my pronunciation this week.
She works for an international company.
她在一家国际公司工作。
My brother works as a designer.
I enjoy working with this team.
我喜欢和这个团队共事。
I hope the new review plan works out.
我希望新的复习计划能奏效。
Let us work through the difficult questions together.
我们一起逐步处理这些难题。
derivatives: 泛指从事某类工作的人。
常见于 working hours 和 working model。

try.en: to make an effort or test a possible method
uses: Try to explain the answer in your own words.
尽量用自己的话解释答案。
Try reading the sentence aloud before you translate it.
翻译前试着朗读这个句子。
You can try the new review mode out today.
你今天可以试用新的复习模式。
Try your best, but do not rush through the questions.
尽力而为，但不要匆忙做题。
If the answer is wrong, try again after reading the hint.
如果答案错了，读完提示再试一次。
I need to try this jacket on before buying it.
买之前我需要试穿这件夹克。
derivatives: 表示某段经历很考验人。

let.en: to allow something to happen or permit someone to act
uses: Let me explain the difference with an example.
让我用一个例子解释差异。
Do not let one mistake stop your practice.
不要让一个错误中断练习。
Please let me know when the sync is complete.
It is time to let go of the habit of translating every word.
该改掉逐字翻译的习惯了。
I do not want to let my team down.
She let out a sigh of relief after the test.
测试结束后她松了一口气。

call.en: to contact by phone, name, or ask someone to come
uses: I will call you back after the meeting.
会议结束后我会给你回电话。
We call this kind of review active recall.
我们把这种复习称为主动回忆。
This problem calls for a careful solution.
这个问题需要谨慎的解决方案。
The teacher called on me to answer the question.
老师点名让我回答问题。
They had to call off the trip because of the storm.
他们因暴风雨不得不取消行程。
It is polite to call new colleagues by the names they prefer.
按新同事喜欢的称呼叫他们是礼貌的。
derivatives: 可指强烈使命感或职业。

may.en: used to express possibility or formal permission
uses: You may see this verb in both formal and informal writing.
你可能会在正式和非正式写作中看到这个动词。
may be able to do something
We may be able to finish before noon.
我们或许能在中午前完成。
The app may have saved your answer already.
应用可能已经保存了你的答案。
May I ask one more question?
我可以再问一个问题吗？
She may well become the best speaker in the group.
她很可能成为小组里口语最好的人。
The same phrase may or may not sound natural in another context.
同一个短语在另一种语境中可能自然，也可能不自然。

feel.en: to experience an emotion or physical sensation, or have an opinion
uses: I feel more confident about speaking after regular practice.
规律练习后，我对口语更有信心。
I feel like taking a short break.
I feel that the explanation needs a clearer example.
我觉得这个解释需要一个更清楚的例子。
I feel sorry for anyone who lost saved progress.
我为丢失已保存进度的人感到难过。
Feel free to ask if the difference is still unclear.
如果差异仍不清楚，请随时提问。
At first, you may need to feel your way through the new interface.
一开始你可能需要摸索着熟悉新界面。
derivatives: 可指数种感觉、情绪或看法。

ask.en: to request information, help, or permission
uses: Do not be afraid to ask a specific question.
不要害怕提出具体问题。
I asked her to check the final sentence.
我请她检查最后一个句子。
You can ask for help when the instructions are unclear.
说明不清楚时你可以求助。
He called to ask about the class schedule.
他打电话询问课程安排。
You should ask permission before sharing someone’s photo.
分享他人照片前应该征得许可。
Ask yourself whether the sentence matches the stated meaning.
问问自己这个句子是否符合给出的含义。

talk.en: to speak with someone or discuss a subject
uses: I need to talk to my teacher about this mistake.
我需要和老师谈谈这个错误。
Let us talk about how the sentence could sound more natural.
我们来谈谈怎样让句子更自然。
She talked me into joining the speaking group.
她说服我加入了口语小组。
talk someone out of doing something
He talked me out of deleting all the data.
他劝我不要删除所有数据。
Can we talk through the plan one step at a time?
我们能逐步详细讨论这个计划吗？
It helps to talk openly about learning difficulties.
坦诚谈论学习困难会有帮助。
derivatives: 指具有某种谈话特点的人。

keep.en: to continue, retain, or cause something to remain in a state
uses: Keep practicing even when a word feels difficult.
即使某个词很难，也要继续练习。
Cloud sync should keep your progress safe.
云同步应该能保护好你的进度。
Keep the full context in mind when you choose an answer.
选择答案时要记住完整语境。
A weak connection should not keep you from reviewing offline.
网络连接不佳不应妨碍你离线复习。
Daily practice helps you keep up with the review schedule.
每日练习能帮助你跟上复习计划。
The app keeps track of every completed question.
应用会记录每道已完成的题。
derivatives: 可指负责看守的人或值得留下的东西。

leave.en: to go away, allow something to remain, or cause a state
uses: I usually leave home at seven thirty.
Do not leave any required word behind when you revise the sentence.
修改句子时不要漏掉任何必需的词。
Please leave me alone while I finish the test.
我完成测试时请别打扰我。
You can leave the page open and return later.
你可以让页面保持打开，稍后再回来。
We leave for Shanghai early tomorrow.
我们明天一早动身去上海。
Leave the final decision to the project owner.
把最终决定交给项目负责人。
derivatives: 常用于 leaving date 或 leaving party。

put.en: to place something somewhere or express it in words
uses: Put the new phrase in your own example sentence.
把新短语用在你自己的例句里。
Try to put today’s feedback into practice.
尽量把今天的反馈付诸实践。
A complete example puts the new word in context.
完整例句把新词放进了语境。
Do not put off reviewing the cards that are due today.
不要推迟复习今天到期的词卡。
You should not have to put up with repeated sync failures.
你不应该忍受反复的同步失败。
Let me put it another way with a shorter sentence.
让我用更短的句子换一种说法。

like.en: to enjoy, approve of, or prefer someone or something
uses: I like reviewing words in short sessions.
我喜欢用短时段复习单词。
I like to read each example aloud once.
我喜欢把每个例句朗读一遍。
I would like to see a clearer explanation.
我想看到更清楚的解释。
I like people to tell me exactly what needs changing.
我希望别人明确告诉我哪里需要修改。
I like the second example better because it sounds natural.
我更喜欢第二个例子，因为它听起来更自然。
How do you like the new study layout?
你觉得新的学习布局怎么样？
derivatives: 常见于 take a liking to。
描述容易让人喜欢的人或品质。

help.en: to make it easier for someone to do something or improve a situation
uses: Clear examples help learners understand the structure.
清晰的例句帮助学习者理解结构。
This guide will help you to review more efficiently.
这份指南会帮助你更高效地复习。
Could you help with the final check?
你能帮忙做最终检查吗？
Please help yourself to some water.
I cannot help noticing the missing word in that sentence.
我忍不住注意到那个句子漏了一个词。
Real-time saving helps solve the repeated-progress problem.
实时保存有助于解决进度重复的问题。
derivatives: 指提供帮助的人或工具。
表示无法控制或处理情况。

start.en: to begin an activity, process, or movement
uses: I start reviewing as soon as I finish breakfast.
我吃完早餐就开始复习。
The examples start to feel familiar after several reviews.
复习几次后，这些例句开始变得熟悉。
Let us start with the highest-frequency verb.
我们从词频最高的动词开始。
You should not need to start from scratch after reopening the app.
重新打开应用后，你不应该需要从头开始。
It only takes a minute to get started.
开始行动只需要一分钟。
The phone starts the app up quickly.
手机能快速启动这个应用。
derivatives: 启动器；开胃菜；先发选手

show.en: to let someone see something or make information clear
uses: Please show me the sentence you want to improve.
请给我看你想改进的句子。
The app shows the saved answer to the learner.
应用向学习者显示已保存的答案。
The results show that regular review improves recall.
结果表明规律复习能提高记忆。
show someone how to do something
Can you show me how to pronounce this word?
你能教我怎么读这个词吗？
All five due cards should show up in today’s review.
今天到期的五张词卡都应该出现在复习中。
I will show you around the new office.
我会带你参观新办公室。
derivatives: 可指展示活动或某次表现。

might.en: used to express a weaker possibility or tentative suggestion
uses: You might remember the word better after using it.
使用这个词后你可能会记得更牢。
might be able to do something
We might be able to finish the update today.
我们或许今天能完成更新。
The browser might have restored an older local copy.
浏览器可能恢复了一份较旧的本地副本。
We might as well check every card while we are here.
既然在这里，我们不妨检查每张词卡。
you might want to do something
You might want to refresh the page after deployment.
部署后你或许应该刷新页面。
One example might not be enough to teach the difference.
一个例子可能不足以讲清区别。

hear.en: to perceive sound or receive information
uses: I can hear a slight difference between the two vowels.
我能听出这两个元音之间的细微差异。
We heard her read the whole paragraph aloud.
我们听见她朗读了整段文字。
I heard someone speaking in the next room.
我听见隔壁房间有人在说话。
Did you hear about the change to the schedule?
I hope to hear from the support team soon.
我希望很快收到支持团队的消息。
I am glad to hear that your progress was saved.
听说你的进度已保存，我很高兴。
derivatives: 可指感官能力或正式听证程序。
指未经直接证实的信息。

play.en: to take part in a game, perform music, or act a role
uses: We play a short word game at the end of class.
我们在下课前玩一个简短的单词游戏。
She plays music quietly while she studies.
她学习时会轻声播放音乐。
Context plays an important role in choosing the right meaning.
语境在选择正确含义时起重要作用。
Do not play with the settings during the test.
测试期间不要摆弄设置。
Our team will play against the champions tomorrow.
我们队明天将对阵冠军队。
Play the recording back and listen for the final sound.
回放录音，留意最后一个音。
derivatives: 可指参与游戏的人或播放设备。
常形容语气、设计或性格。

turn.en: to move around, change direction, or become different
uses: Turn left at the next traffic light.
在下一个红绿灯处左转。
Daily practice can turn passive words into active vocabulary.
每日练习能把被动词汇变成主动词汇。
Turn the sound on before the pronunciation exercise.
发音练习前请打开声音。
Please turn notifications off during the test.
The missing record turned out to be a sync problem.
那条缺失的记录最后证明是同步问题。
We take turns reading the dialogue aloud.
derivatives: 可指道路转弯或发展转折。
常用于商业和人力资源语境。

run.en: to move quickly, operate, or manage an activity or organization
uses: She runs a small online business from home.
她在家经营一家小型网店。
This phone can run the app smoothly.
这部手机能流畅运行这个应用。
We ran out of time, but you can still learn the phrase run out of something.
我们时间用完了，但你仍可以学习短语 run out of something。
Tell me if you run into a problem during review.
复习时如果遇到问题，请告诉我。
Let us run through the questions before the test.
测试前我们快速过一遍题目。
The scheduled task runs on the server, not on your phone.
定时任务在服务器上运行，而不是在你的手机上。
derivatives: 可指运动者，也可用于技术语境。

live.en: to be alive or make a home in a place
uses: I live in Shanghai and work from home.
She lives with her parents near the university.
她和父母住在大学附近。
Regular sleep helps you live a healthier life.
规律睡眠有助于过更健康的生活。
Many students live on a limited budget.
许多学生靠有限的预算生活。
The new version needs to live up to users’ expectations.
新版本需要达到用户的期望。
Some expressions live through generations of change.
有些表达历经数代变化仍在使用。
derivatives: 作名词可指生计，作形容词表示活着的。

bring.en: to carry something toward a place or cause a result
uses: Bring your notes with you to the study session.
参加学习活动时请带上笔记。
Could you bring me a glass of water?
Please bring the problem to the team’s attention.
请让团队注意到这个问题。
Small changes can bring about lasting improvement.
小改变能带来持久进步。
I want to bring up one issue with the new plan.
我想提出新计划中的一个问题。
A clear example can bring the meaning back to mind.
清楚的例句能帮助你重新想起含义。
derivatives: 较少单独使用，多见于固定结构。

move.en: to change position, progress, or cause an emotional response
uses: We plan to move to a quieter neighborhood.
我们打算搬到一个更安静的社区。
The new evidence will move the discussion forward.
新证据会推动讨论进展。
When you understand this example, move on to the next one.
理解这个例子后，继续下一个。
We should move away from mechanical translation.
我们应该摆脱机械翻译。
Her honest speech moved everyone deeply.
她真诚的讲话深深打动了大家。
It is time to make a move and start the review.
该采取行动开始复习了。
derivatives: 可指身体移动、社会运动或乐章。

must.en: used to express necessity, strong obligation, or a confident conclusion
uses: You must save the answer before closing the page.
关闭页面前必须保存答案。
If all devices show the same record, the cloud copy must be current.
如果所有设备显示同一记录，云端副本一定是最新的。
You must not include private system text in user feedback.
用户反馈中禁止包含系统内部文本。
The browser must have restored an older cached version.
浏览器一定恢复了较旧的缓存版本。
must be able to do something
The app must be able to resume an unfinished review.
应用必须能够恢复未完成的复习。
If you must reset the data, check the account status first.
如果你一定要重置数据，请先检查账号状态。

begin.en: to start an action, process, or period
uses: I begin to understand the pattern after seeing two examples.
看过两个例子后，我开始理解这个句型。
She begins reviewing at the same time every morning.
她每天早上同一时间开始复习。
The lesson begins with the most common meaning.
课程从最常见的含义开始。
Begin by reading the sentence without translating it.
You can begin again from the last saved question.
你可以从上次保存的题目重新开始。
Read the dialogue from beginning to end before answering.
回答前从头到尾读完对话。
derivatives: 指刚开始学习某项技能的人。

love.en: to feel deep affection or greatly enjoy something
uses: I love learning expressions that I can use immediately.
我喜欢学习能立刻使用的表达。
We love to walk by the river after dinner.
我们喜欢晚饭后沿河散步。
I would love to visit the museum this weekend.
我这周末很想去参观博物馆。
I love the way she explains difficult ideas.
我喜欢她解释难点的方式。
He fell in love with the city, but today we practice love as a verb.
他爱上了这座城市；今天我们练习动词 love。
derivatives: 常形容家庭关系或行为。

hold.en: to keep something in the hands, maintain a state, or organize an event
uses: Hold the phone firmly while you record your answer.
录制答案时请拿稳手机。
We hold a short meeting every Monday morning.
我们每周一早上开一个短会。
The manager will hold each team member responsible for the result.
经理会让每位团队成员对结果负责。
Hold on while I check the date.
等一下，我核对一下日期。
Fear of mistakes can hold you back from speaking.
害怕犯错会妨碍你开口。
This rule does not hold true in every context.
这条规则并非在所有语境中都成立。
derivatives: 可指权利持有人或用于固定物体的装置。
常用于金融或法律语境。

stop.en: to end an action or prevent something from happening
uses: Stop translating every word before you understand the sentence.
不要在理解句子前逐字翻译。
I stopped to check the pronunciation before continuing.
我停下来查了发音，然后继续。
A temporary error should not stop you from studying offline.
临时错误不应阻止你离线学习。
The bus came to a stop near the station.
公交车在车站附近停了下来。
I will stop by the library after work.
下班后我会顺便去图书馆。
The old printer sometimes stops working without warning.
旧打印机有时会毫无预兆地停止工作。

pay.en: to give money, attention, or a particular cost
uses: I paid for the book online, but the core phrase is pay for something.
我在网上为这本书付款；核心短语是 pay for something。
The company pays writers for each article.
公司按文章向作者付费。
Pay attention to the verb form after to.
注意 to 后面的动词形式。
We pay a price when we ignore repeated mistakes.
忽视反复出现的错误会让我们付出代价。
Daily practice pays off over time.
每日练习最终会得到回报。
I will pay you back on Friday.

lose.en: to no longer have something or fail to win
uses: It is easy to lose your way without a clear plan.
没有清晰计划很容易迷失方向。
Be careful not to lose your saved notes.
小心别丢失保存的笔记。
Repetitive exercises can make learners lose interest.
重复的练习会让学习者失去兴趣。
I do not want to lose touch with my old classmates.
我不想和老同学失去联系。
Our team may lose a game and still learn from it.
我们队可能输掉比赛，但仍能从中学习。
Try the new method—you have nothing to lose.
试试新方法吧，你没有什么可失去的。
derivatives: 可指数据、金钱、机会或亲人离世。
指比赛或竞争中失败的人。

wait.en: to stay until someone arrives or something happens
uses: I will wait for you outside the station.
Please wait to submit until you have checked the sentence.
I cannot wait to try the new lesson.
我迫不及待想试试新课程。
Let us wait and see whether the weather improves.
我们等等看天气是否好转。
I am sorry to keep you waiting.
We had to wait in line for twenty minutes.
我们排了二十分钟的队。
derivatives: 指餐厅中提供服务的男性员工。

meet.en: to come together, encounter, or satisfy a requirement
uses: I will meet my study partner after work.
下班后我会和学习伙伴见面。
Every new card must meet the full content requirements.
每张新词卡都必须满足完整内容要求。
We need to meet the Friday deadline.
我们需要在周五截止日期前完成。
The revised plan should meet the learner’s actual needs.
修订后的计划应该满足学习者的实际需要。
I am meeting with my manager this afternoon.
我今天下午要和经理会面。
Both sides agreed to meet halfway.
derivatives: 可指正式会议或一般见面。

uses: I want to thank you for your detailed feedback.
我想感谢你的详细反馈。
She thanked me for checking the report.
Thank you for your help with the final review.
感谢你帮助完成最终复核。
I have my teacher to thank for this improvement.
I cannot thank you enough for your patience.
Thank goodness we found the missing document.
谢天谢地，我们找到了丢失的文件。

watch.en: to look at something carefully over a period of time
uses: Watch the video once without reading the subtitles.
先不看字幕把视频看一遍。
We watched the chef prepare the whole meal.
我们看着厨师做完了整顿饭。
I watched her practicing the same sentence.
我看着她在练习同一个句子。
Watch out for the spelling change in the past tense.
注意过去式的拼写变化。
Watch closely as I move my lips.
仔细看我的嘴唇如何移动。
Watch what you say when the topic is sensitive.
话题敏感时要注意措辞。
derivatives: 表示持续注意潜在问题。

sit.en: to rest on a seat or remain in a particular position
uses: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
I sit next to a helpful colleague at work.
我工作时坐在一位乐于助人的同事旁边。
Try not to sit at a desk for too many hours.
尽量不要在书桌前坐太久。
Please sit still while I take the photo.
It was hard to sit through such a long meeting.
坚持坐完这么长的会议很难。
Sit back and relax after you finish the review.
完成复习后靠后坐着放松一下。
derivatives: 可指一次连续就座的时段或坐姿。

kill.en: to cause death or bring an activity or process to an end
uses: I read short articles to kill time on the train.
我在火车上读短文消磨时间。
Harsh criticism can kill a good idea too early.
严厉批评可能过早扼杀好想法。
A loud alarm can kill the mood in a quiet room.
响亮的闹铃会破坏安静房间的气氛。
Do not kill the process while it is saving your work.
保存工作时不要终止进程。
Many people are killed in road accidents each year.
每年有许多人死于道路事故。
kill two birds with one stone
Walking to the store can kill two birds with one stone: exercise and shopping.
步行去商店能一举两得：锻炼和购物。
derivatives: 可作名词，也可非正式地表示极难或极强。

stand.en: to be upright, tolerate something, or represent an idea
uses: Stand still while I adjust the camera.
我调整相机时请站着别动。
I cannot stand waiting without any information.
我无法忍受在没有任何信息时一直等待。
What does this abbreviation stand for?
A natural example helps the key pattern stand out.
自然例句能让核心句型更突出。
Good friends stand by you during difficult times.
困难时期，好朋友会支持你。
You stand a better chance of remembering a word when you use it.
使用一个词会增加你记住它的机会。
derivatives: 可指社会地位，也可表示长期存在。
常见于 from a practical standpoint。

set.en: to put something in position, establish, or decide a value or time
uses: Set a realistic goal for this week.
为本周设定一个现实目标。
Let us set a time for the next meeting.
我们定一下下次会议的时间。
I set twenty minutes aside for review each morning.
我每天早上留出二十分钟复习。
She set up a quiet place to study.
她布置了一个安静的学习空间。
The court decided to set him free.
The story is set in a small coastal town.
这个故事以一座海滨小镇为背景。
derivatives: 可指设备设置或故事背景。
来自相关动词 settle，并非 set 的直接规则变形。

win.en: to be successful in a contest or gain something through effort
uses: Our team hopes to win the game tonight.
我们队希望今晚赢得比赛。
She won a prize, but the useful pattern is win a prize.
她赢得了奖项；实用搭配是 win a prize。
Clear communication helps you win people’s trust.
清晰沟通有助于赢得他人的信任。
The goal is not to win the argument but to understand each other.
目标不是赢得争论，而是相互理解。
Her practical plan won over the whole team.
她切实可行的计划说服了整个团队。
The company is trying to win back customer confidence.
公司正努力重新赢得客户信心。
derivatives: 指比赛或竞争中获胜的人。
可形容方案、球队或笑容。

lead.en: to guide, be ahead, or cause a particular result
uses: She leads a small design team.
她带领一个小型设计团队。
Unclear questions can lead to unreliable results.
不清楚的题目会导致不可靠的结果。
The evidence led us to change the plan.
证据促使我们改变计划。
Good examples lead the way to natural expression.
好的例句为自然表达指明方向。
带领某人逐步完成某事
The guide leads you through each review stage.
指南带你逐步完成每个复习阶段。

stay.en: to remain in a place or continue in a state
uses: I stayed home, but I still practice the phrase stay at home.
我待在家里；这里继续练习短语 stay at home。
Try to stay focused for ten minutes at a time.
I stay in touch with my classmates online.
我通过网络和同学保持联系。
Stay away from word-for-word translation when the context differs.
语境不同时，要避免逐字翻译。
Do not stay up late just to finish one lesson.
不要为了完成一节课而熬夜。
The word can stay the same while its function changes.
同一个词可以形式不变而功能改变。
derivatives: 作名词可指一段停留时间。

add.en: to put something together with something else or say more
uses: Add one natural example to each new phrase.
给每个新短语加一个自然例句。
The small costs add up to a large amount.
这些小额费用加起来是一大笔。
She added that the meeting would start early.
她补充说会议会提前开始。
Specific feedback adds value to the lesson.
具体反馈能提升课程价值。
Please add me to the study group.
His explanation does not add up.

die.en: to stop living, disappear, or stop functioning
uses: Many people still die of preventable diseases.
仍有许多人死于可预防的疾病。
Plants may die from too much heat.
植物可能因高温而死亡。
Some local expressions die out over time.
一些地方表达会逐渐消失。
The noise began to die down after midnight.
午夜后噪声开始逐渐减弱。
Her footsteps died away in the distance, but the base verb is die.
她的脚步声渐渐消失；基础动词是 die。
I am dying to know the result.
derivatives: 表示生命结束这一事实或事件。
可形容生物或设备、电池。
常表示能致死或程度很高。

buy.en: to obtain something by paying money or accept an idea as true
uses: She bought a gift, but the pattern to remember is buy something for someone.
她买了礼物；要记的结构是 buy something for someone。
We buy fresh vegetables from a local farmer.
我们从当地农户那里购买新鲜蔬菜。
Not everyone will buy into the new plan immediately.
不是每个人都会立刻接受新计划。
The temporary fix will buy us time to find a better solution.
临时修复会为我们争取时间寻找更好的方案。
买不到某物；无法用钱获得
金钱买不到真正的信任。
derivatives: 指购买商品或负责采购的人。

send.en: to cause something or someone to go to a destination
uses: Please send me a message when you arrive.
I will send the document to the team this afternoon.
我今天下午会把文件发给团队。
The company will send her to Beijing for training.
公司会派她去北京培训。
Send the product back if it is damaged.
如果产品损坏，请把它寄回。
We send out a reminder every Friday.
The receptionist sent for a doctor immediately.
接待员立即派人去请医生。
derivatives: 常用于邮件、包裹和信息。
较少单独使用，多见于技术语境。

walk.en: to move on foot or accompany someone on foot
uses: I walk to work when the weather is good.
We walked by the river, but the practice phrase is walk along the river.
我们沿河散步；练习短语是 walk along the river。
I will walk you home after the meeting.
会议结束后我陪你走回家。
You can walk away from an unfair agreement.
你可以退出不公平的协议。
She walked into the room and introduced herself, while we practice walk into a room.
她走进房间并作了自我介绍；我们练习 walk into a room。
The trainer will walk you through the process.
培训师会带你逐步了解流程。
derivatives: 可指步行的人或帮助行走的器具。

grow.en: to become larger, develop, or change gradually
uses: The small company continues to grow quickly.
这家小公司继续快速发展。
A daily habit can grow into a lasting skill.
每日习惯能发展成持久技能。
Children grow up at different speeds.
孩子们成长的速度各不相同。
Learners may grow tired of repetitive questions.
学习者可能逐渐厌倦重复的题目。
You will grow in confidence as you speak more often.
随着开口次数增加，你会越来越自信。
We grow tomatoes from seed every spring.
我们每年春天用种子种番茄。
derivatives: 可指身体、经济或能力增长。

open.en: to make something accessible or begin operating
uses: You can open an account with your email address.
你可以用电子邮箱开设账户。
The library opens its study rooms to local students.
图书馆向本地学生开放自习室。
She began to open up about her concerns.
她开始敞开心扉谈自己的担忧。
The speaker opened with a short personal story.
演讲者以一个简短的个人故事开场。
The agreement could open the way for closer cooperation.
这项协议可能为更紧密的合作铺平道路。
derivatives: 可指空缺、开口或开始阶段。
常用于描述态度或制度。

hope.en: to want something to happen and believe it is possible
uses: I hope to finish today’s review before dinner.
我希望在晚饭前完成今天的复习。
We hope that the weather will improve tomorrow.
我们希望明天天气会好转。
The team hopes for a clear decision this week.
团队希望本周能有明确决定。
I hope you can join us for lunch.
我希望你能和我们一起吃午饭。
We prepared carefully and now we can hope for the best.
我们已认真准备，现在可以期待最好的结果。
There is still hope if we act quickly.
如果迅速行动，仍然有希望。
derivatives: 作名词常见于 hope for、in the hope of。
常用于表达对结果的期待。

build.en: to construct something or develop it gradually
uses: They plan to build a small house near the lake.
他们计划在湖边建一座小房子。
Short daily sessions help you build a lasting habit.
每日短时学习有助于养成持久习惯。
Speaking regularly will build your confidence.
经常开口会增强你的信心。
以某事为基础继续发展
Today’s lesson builds on what you learned yesterday.
今天的课程建立在你昨天所学的基础上。
We need to build regular review into the weekly plan.
我们需要把定期复习纳入每周计划。
Reading widely helps you build up your vocabulary.
广泛阅读有助于逐步扩大词汇量。
derivatives: 可指建筑工人或创建事物的人。
可指实体建筑或建设过程。

fall.en: to move downward, drop in amount, or enter a state
uses: Be careful not to fall to the ground on the icy path.
结冰的路上小心别摔倒。
Sales may fall by ten percent this quarter.
本季度销售额可能下降百分之十。
I often fall asleep quickly after reading.
我经常读完书很快入睡。
It is easy to fall behind when reviews are repeatedly skipped.
反复跳过复习很容易落后。
This example does not fall into the same category.
这个例子不属于同一类别。
The old box will fall apart if you lift it.
这个旧箱子一抬就会散架。
derivatives: 作名词可表示下落或美式英语中的秋季。

appear.en: to become visible, be present, or seem to have a quality
uses: The saved answer should appear on the screen immediately.
已保存的答案应该立即出现在屏幕上。
The task appears to be easier than yesterday’s.
这项任务似乎比昨天的容易。
This phrase often appears in business emails.
这个短语经常出现在商务邮件中。
A small boat appeared from behind the island.
The team appears likely to reach its goal.
团队看起来很可能实现目标。
The character first appears in the second chapter.
这个人物首次出现在第二章。
derivatives: 常见于 it became apparent that。
表示根据现有信息作出判断。

serve.en: to provide help or food, perform a duty, or be useful for a purpose
uses: Good staff serve every customer politely.
优秀员工会礼貌地服务每位顾客。
The restaurant serves breakfast until ten.
这家餐厅供应早餐到十点。
This sentence can serve as a useful model.
这个句子可以作为实用范例。
Every question should serve a clear learning purpose.
每道题都应该有明确的学习目的。
She serves on the school’s safety committee.
她在学校安全委员会任职。
This habit will serve you well in future conversations.
这个习惯会在今后的对话中给你很大帮助。
derivatives: 可指提供帮助的活动或设备维护。
可指提供餐饮服务的人或网络设备。

break.en: to damage, divide, interrupt, or fail to obey something
uses: Do not break the rule just because the task feels difficult.
不要因为任务困难就违反规则。
Break the sentence into smaller parts before translating it.
翻译前把句子分成更小的部分。
It takes time to break the habit of translating word for word.
改掉逐字翻译的习惯需要时间。
The old machine may break down without regular maintenance.
旧机器不定期维护可能会出故障。
A fire could break out if the wiring is damaged.
电线损坏可能引发火灾。
I had to break the bad news to the team.
我不得不把坏消息告诉团队。
derivatives: 常用于运输或保险语境。

end.en: to finish or cause something to finish
uses: Let us end the meeting with a clear decision.
让我们以一个明确决定结束会议。
The lesson ends with a short speaking task.
课程以一个简短口语任务结束。
The discussion may end in an agreement.
讨论可能以达成协议告终。
Without a plan, you may end up repeating the same mistakes.
没有计划，你最终可能会重复同样的错误。
The final vote will bring the debate to an end.
最终投票会结束这场辩论。
Try to end the day on a positive note.
尽量以积极的心情结束一天。
derivatives: 常指故事、电影或单词结尾。
常形容讨论、等待或可能性。
是表达结束结果的常用副词，但并非 end 的规则派生。

agree.en: to have the same opinion or accept a proposal
uses: I agree with you about the need for clearer examples.
我同意你关于需要更清楚例句的看法。
Both sides agreed to the new schedule.
She agreed to check the final document.
We agree that the first sentence sounds more natural.
我们一致认为第一个句子更自然。
The team needs to agree on a launch date.
团队需要就发布日期达成一致。
Spicy food does not agree with me.
辛辣食物不适合我的胃。
derivatives: 可指正式协议或意见一致。

cut.en: to divide with a sharp tool, reduce, or interrupt something
uses: Cut the apple into small pieces.
The company needs to cut costs without reducing quality.
公司需要在不降低质量的情况下削减成本。
I am trying to cut down on late-night screen time.
我正努力减少深夜看屏幕的时间。
Cut the unrelated sentence out of the paragraph.
把段落中无关的句子删掉。
I am sorry to cut you off, but we are out of time.
抱歉打断你，但我们没有时间了。
A clear example can cut through the confusion.
清楚的例子能消除困惑。
derivatives: 可指切割过程或言辞尖刻。

pass.en: to move past, succeed in a test, or give something to someone
uses: Regular practice can help you pass the test.
规律练习能帮助你通过考试。
Please pass the report to your manager.
We pass through this station every morning.
我们每天早上经过这个车站。
Do not pass on information that has not been checked.
不要传播未经核实的信息。
Do not pass up an opportunity to practice speaking.
不要错过练习口语的机会。
Time passes quickly when I am focused.
derivatives: 可指文章段落或通行路径。

eat.en: to put food in the mouth and swallow it
uses: I eat breakfast before I begin studying.
We eat out on Friday evenings.
我们周五晚上外出吃饭。
It is easier to concentrate when you eat healthily.
健康饮食时更容易集中注意力。
The children quickly ate the fruit, but the useful pattern is eat something up.
孩子们很快吃光了水果；实用短语是 eat something up。
Repeated delays eat into the time available for practice.
反复延误会逐渐占用可用于练习的时间。
Let us have something to eat before we continue.
继续之前我们吃点东西吧。
derivatives: 语义相关，但词形来源不同。

report.en: to give an official account or provide information about an event
uses: Please report the problem as soon as it happens.
问题发生后请尽快报告。
I reported the error to the support team.
我向支持团队报告了错误。
The newspaper reports that prices are falling.
报纸报道说价格正在下降。
She will report on the project’s progress tomorrow.
她明天会汇报项目进度。
The company is reported to plan another expansion.
据报道，这家公司计划再次扩张。
All new staff must report for duty at nine.
所有新员工必须九点报到上班。
derivatives: 作名词可指正式文件或新闻报道。
指报道新闻或提交报告的人。

sell.en: to exchange something for money or persuade someone to accept an idea
uses: 他们在网上出售手工包。
The store sells fresh bread to local customers.
这家商店向本地顾客出售新鲜面包。
These tickets sell for fifty dollars each.
这些票每张售价五十美元。
Popular courses often sell out quickly.
热门课程经常很快售罄。
The clear evidence sold the team on the new plan.
清楚的证据说服团队接受了新计划。
Practical books tend to sell well.
实用书籍往往卖得很好。

receive.en: to get something that is sent, given, or communicated
uses: I received your message this morning.
我今天早上收到了你的消息。
You will receive a confirmation email from the school.
你会收到学校发来的确认邮件。
Every learner should receive help when a problem repeats.
问题反复出现时，每位学习者都应该得到帮助。
The issue did not receive enough attention at first.
这个问题起初没有得到足够重视。
The host family received us warmly.
寄宿家庭热情地接待了我们。
The new lesson format was well received by students.
新的课程形式很受学生欢迎。
derivatives: 可指接收信息的人或设备部件。

base.en: to use something as the foundation for a decision or locate operations somewhere
uses: Base your answer on the complete sentence, not one isolated word.
回答要以完整句子为依据，而不是孤立的一个词。
The review plan is based on your recent performance.
复习计划以你最近的表现为基础。
We should base the decision on facts.
我们应该根据事实作决定。
base a story on real events
根据真实事件创作故事
The writer based the story on real events.
作者根据真实事件创作了这个故事。
The company bases its design team in Shanghai.
公司把设计团队设在上海。
Always base your calculations on verified data.
计算时始终以核实过的数据为基础。
derivatives: 作名词可指支撑物、起点或据点。
常见于 on the basis of。

pick.en: to choose, gather, or lift something
uses: Read every choice before you pick an option.
选择前把每个选项都读一遍。
You can pick up useful expressions from podcasts.
你可以从播客中学到实用表达。
The coach picked Maya for the final team.
教练选玛雅进入最终队伍。
Can you pick the key phrase out of this paragraph?
你能从这段话中找出核心短语吗？
He picked at his lunch because he was nervous.
他因为紧张，只是一点点地吃午饭。
Pick your words carefully when you give feedback.
给出反馈时要谨慎措辞。
derivatives: 可指从事采摘的人或选择工具。

drive.en: to control a vehicle, power a process, or strongly motivate someone
uses: I drive a car to work twice a week.
Can you drive me to the station tomorrow?
你明天能开车送我去车站吗？
Honest feedback can drive meaningful change.
真实反馈能推动有意义的改变。
The repeated failures drove us to redesign the process.
反复失败迫使我们重新设计流程。
A clear goal helps drive the project forward.
清晰目标有助于推动项目前进。
把某人逼疯；使极其恼火
The constant noise drives me crazy.
持续的噪声让我非常烦躁。
derivatives: 可指开车的人或造成变化的因素。

hit.en: to strike, collide with, or reach a particular level
uses: Try to hit the ball with the center of the racket.
We hope to hit our weekly learning target.
我们希望达到每周学习目标。
The unexpected news hit him hard.
这个意外消息对他打击很大。
We hit a problem during the final test.
我们在最终测试中遇到了问题。
We should hit the road before traffic gets heavy.
我们应该在交通拥堵前出发。
Hit record when you are ready to speak.
准备好说话时按下录音键。
derivatives: 作名词可指一次击中或成功作品。

pull.en: to move something toward oneself or use force to draw it
uses: Pull the card out of the box and read it aloud.
从盒子里抽出词卡并朗读。
We need to pull the final report together today.
我们今天需要把最终报告整理好。
The train began to pull away from the station.
With proper care, she should pull through.
得到适当照顾后，她应该能康复。
把某人拉到一旁私下谈
The teacher pulled me aside to discuss my progress.
老师把我叫到一旁讨论我的进步。
derivatives: 作名词可指拉动或影响力。
常用于复合词或工具名称。

raise.en: to lift, increase, collect, or bring a subject forward
uses: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
The result raises an important question about timing.
这个结果提出了一个关于时机的重要问题。
The company may raise prices next month.
We are raising money for the local library.
我们正在为当地藏书楼筹款。
The campaign aims to raise awareness of online safety.
这项活动旨在提高网络安全意识。
It takes patience to raise a child.

wear.en: to have clothing on the body or become damaged through use
uses: Wear a warm coat because it is cold outside.
外面很冷，请穿件暖和的外套。
I wear glasses when I read small print.
She wears her hair short in summer.
Long meetings can wear people out.
冗长的会议会让人筋疲力尽。
The lettering will wear away over time.
这些字样会随着时间逐渐磨损。
This jacket wears well even after years of use.
这件夹克穿了多年仍很耐用。
derivatives: 常用于科技和服装语境。

return.en: to go back, give something back, or come back to a state
uses: I will return home before dinner.
Please return the book to the library by Friday.
请在周五前把书还给图书馆。
Let us return to the main question.
The service should return to normal soon.
服务应该很快恢复正常。
I will return your call after the meeting.
会议结束后我会给你回电话。
derivatives: 作名词含义取决于旅行、投资或购物语境。

cause.en: to make something happen, especially a result or problem
uses: A missing context can cause a serious misunderstanding.
缺少语境会导致严重误解。
The delay caused us to change the schedule.
延误导致我们更改日程。
Heavy rain can cause damage to old buildings.
暴雨会对老建筑造成损害。
The sudden drop in sales caused concern.
销售额突然下降引起了担忧。
Vague wording can cause confusion for learners.
含糊措辞会让学习者困惑。
You may cause an error by closing the page too early.
过早关闭页面可能会导致错误。
derivatives: 作名词可指原因或得到支持的事业。
多用于正式或学术语境。

join.en: to become part of a group or connect things together
uses: I joined a small speaking group last month.
我上个月加入了一个小型口语小组。
Would you like to join us for lunch?
你愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？
Everyone is welcome to join in the discussion.
Join the two pieces with a small screw.
用一颗小螺丝把两块连接起来。
The two teams joined forces, but the phrase to learn is join forces with someone.
两个团队联手了；要学的短语是 join forces with someone。
These two sections join together at the center.
这两个部分在中心连接在一起。
derivatives: 可表示共同拥有或物体连接处。
